description: Engine live wiring + sealed snapshots. Orchestrates the planning-engine canon over tenant-loaded inputs (ports-injected, no direct I/O), maps the portfolio through the kpi-catalog dataState envelope, and seals one immutable snapshot per tenant-day (plan_seal) with a SHA-256 payload hash and the ENGINE_VERSION/SCHEMA_VERSION stamps (L-07). H8 refuses the rate seed before any ref is computed; H6-style replay resolves the day's CURRENT version and discloses a divergent request, never applies it. M8 restatement (§14.16): an explicit, reasoned act landing a NEW version chained beside the immutable seal (plan_seal_restatement, the db door) with the as-known-then vs as-known-now delta and a Class-W RESTATE_DAY ledger block in the same transaction — the H5 chain's first production writer.
